homebrewV2.preservedPayload: This content uses an unrecognized format. Its original fields are preserved.
homebrewV2.setupHelp: Add the specific rules fields to this saved draft.
homebrewV2.effectsHelp: Declare effects in order. These fields describe the content; they do not apply it.
